verdict.line: You lose if he lands E (Apprehend) and stacks Hemorrhage to enrage before level 6; you win if you survive lane and carry the game from Ravenous Hydra and Trinity Force onward.

brief.thesis: Darius wins the ability-for-ability exchange in the first six levels because E (Apprehend) hooks Fiora into range and his passive Hemorrhage rewards him for keeping her there, while Fiora's kit is built to punish shorter, cleaner trades and to take over once items and levels catch up. The 51.2% win rate over 203 games with a stated lane and solo-kill edge to Darius means this is a lane you survive, not one you dominate.

theirWindow.what: Once Apprehend is off cooldown (26/23.5/21/18.5/16s) he can hook you from 535 range and chain into a basic attack or W (Crippling Strike) to slow and stack Hemorrhage; at 6 he adds Noxian Guillotine as a true-damage finisher. Play at max wave range until you see his E cooldown pass.

yourWindow.when: right after he pulls you with E
yourWindow.what: Pop W (Riposte) as he lands the hook, not before, so it parries the guaranteed follow-up attack he needs to stack Hemorrhage and reflects magic damage back at him. That single parry cuts his all-in damage and stack count in half.

powerCurve.note: neither kit has a full combo yet
Q/W cooldowns and AD steroid catch up

start.why: The 92.5%-pick start (50.6% win rate, 235 games) gives the sustain and raw AD needed to survive Darius's early poke and Q (Decimate) trades without losing the wave.

boots.why: 79.1% pick, 53.9% win rate over 178 games — Darius's kill pattern runs through basic attacks (Crippling Strike, post-hook autos), so flat basic-attack mitigation directly answers his damage source.

core.why: Lets you shove and heal off Lunge hits so you can reset waves instead of standing in extended trades where his passive wins.
Damage and move speed spike that synergizes with E (Burst of Speed)'s stacking move speed, letting you disengage or chase once you're ahead on items.
Damage mitigation against his true-damage R (Noxian Guillotine) and bleed stacks, so a bad trade doesn't turn into a kill for him.

situational.when: you're snowballing and want a burst all-in instead of a sustain fight
he builds early tank items and you need extra sustained damage
the lane stabilizes and you want to pressure towers instead of duel
his team stacks CC that would lock you into his engage range

runes.keystoneWhy: PTA's mark-and-burst rewards you for landing three fast hits, which lets you punish extended trades before Darius reaches 5 stacks of Hemorrhage and enrages — it's the higher win-rate page (45.5%) of the two commonly run.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 94.4% and 49.6% win rate — Ignite offsets the healing Darius gets from Q (Decimate) hitting champions with the blade and gives you the extra burst to close out trades once you're ahead.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown constantly
playing.detail: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s. Play at 600+ range (outside 535) whenever it's up, especially levels 3-6.

playing.title: Riposte the hook follow-up, not the hook
playing.detail: W (Riposte) parries his next basic attack — time it for the moment he pulls you in and needs an auto to stack Hemorrhage, not before he engages.

playing.title: Disengage before max stacks
playing.detail: Hemorrhage stacks to 5 and enrages him with massive AD. Use Q (Lunge) to reposition or E (Burst of Speed) to kite out once you're at 3+ stacks.

playing.title: Punish whiffed Q (Decimate)
playing.detail: His Q only heals him if the blade hits a champion, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s. A miss near you is your window to all-in with Q into E.

playing.title: Respect level 6 true damage
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine hits from 460 range and scales with his bleed stacks. Don't sit at low HP in that range once he hits 6.

playing.title: Farm through the disadvantage
playing.detail: Lane and solo-kill favor him, so poke with Q (Lunge) for CS rather than forcing extended trades before your first back.

playing.title: Save R for picks, not lane fights
playing.detail: Blade Waltz is best used post-6 to burst an isolated target across the map, not as an answer to his lane all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing advice are my own read of the ability interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Bring Ignite to pressure Darius in lane. Always use [W] to block his (E).
